# IR35: what does your day rate really pay inside and outside?

> Free UK IR35 calculator: compare contractor take-home outside IR35 (own limited company, best salary and dividends) and inside IR35 (umbrella), and find the inside day rate that matches. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
